page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-8x.16xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on x86_64 architecture and running under the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 64 dedicated vCPUs derived from Intel Xeon 8469C processors operating at a clock speed of 2.6 GHz. System memory totals 768.0 GB, providing an allocation ratio of 12.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

Hardware acceleration on this instance is powered by an array of 8 GPUs delivering a total of 768 GB of GPU VRAM. The instance contains no local ephemeral storage, requiring all persistent and scratch disk operations to use attached network volumes. Connectivity is backed by a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

With its combination of 64 dedicated cores, 768 GB of system RAM, and 768 GB of total VRAM across 8 GPUs, the server provides substantial compute and memory density for parallel workloads. The primary tradeoff is the reliance on external storage due to the lack of local SSDs. This hardware profile fits deep learning training, machine learning inference, computer vision processing, and scientific parallel computing.
